prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t objectively name one single “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case — the right lawyer depends on your injuries, the facts, your goals, and who you feel comfortable working with. I can, however, tell you how to find a top attorney in Chicago and offer next steps so you get good representation.

How to pick a top Chicago car-accident attorney
- Look for plaintiff-side personal injury experience with car collisions (not primarily defense work).
- Proven results: recent settlements or verdicts for car-accident victims. Trial experience is a plus if liability or serious damages are contested.
- Good client reviews and peer recognition (Super Lawyers, Martindale‑Hubbell AV ratings, local legal awards).
- Clear fee structure (contingency fee), and they advance case costs.
- Communication style you prefer (regular updates, accessible staff).
- Willingness to investigate (accident reconstruction, medical records, expert witnesses) and to take cases to trial if the insurer lowballs.

Where to search / verify
- SuperLawyers, Avvo, Martindale‑Hubbell
- Illinois Trial Lawyers Association / Chicago Bar Association referral service
- Google and Yelp reviews (read several, not just one)
- Ask friends/family or your doctor for local referrals

Questions to ask when you call for a free consult
- How many car-accident cases do you handle per year?
- Have you handled cases with injuries like mine (whiplash, TBI, fractures, permanent impairment, wrongful death)?
- What were some recent outcomes for similar cases?
- Who will handle my file day-to-day — partner, associate, paralegal?
- What is your fee and what costs will I be responsible for if we don’t recover?
- Do you have trial experience and, if necessary, will you take my case to trial?

Red flags
- Guarantees of a specific dollar amount
- Pressure to sign immediately
- Poor communication during your initial contact
- No willingness to use or refer to experts when needed

Well-known plaintiff firms in Chicago (to start your search)
- Clifford Law Offices
- Corboy & Demetrio
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard
- Simmons Hanly Conroy

(Verify current reputations and match them to your needs — I’m listing these as well-known firms historically active in major personal-injury work.)

If you want, tell me:
- Your ZIP code or neighborhood
- Brief facts (severity of injuries, fault dispute, uninsured motorist, hit-and-run, any deadline concerns)
I can then suggest 3–5 Chicago attorneys or firms who are a good fit for your specific situation and explain how to contact them.
